column5: - table.rs:1645-1651 (missing declaration file reads as same instance); 2878-2883 (empty-span reference under `Ordinary` takes the first candidate); 2588-2623 (`find_child_by_name` first match wins outside modules); 2547.

- CI/interpreter.rs:772-779, 1102-1106 with CI/evaluation.rs:323-337: a trap, unsupported construct, resource halt or worker panic yields `InterpretOutcome::error` with `exit_code` 0; a caller reading only the exit code sees success.

- CI/build_machine.rs:15-35: `accept_component_assumption(build, digest)` evaluates the digest and returns unit; the digest is not compared, stored or recorded. 758-821: writes through handles not tracked as rooted paths are not counted as post-completion mutations.

- CI/execution.rs:1211-1254, 1391-1471: with `checked == None` (the `Typed` program path) cleanup plans are never consulted; reader's wrong program: an affine cleanup obligation silently not run. 1013-1025: `ReadLine` ignores an unresolvable destination after consuming stdin. 594-693: a build-time argument of a non-`CheckedShape` type is accepted unbound.

- CI/execution_expressions.rs:912-1000: an unresolved, unqualified call named `key_state`, `dc_create`, `get_dc`, `window_create`, `is_window`, `window_destroy`, `foreground_window`, `msg_peek`, `msg_translate`, `msg_dispatch`, `tick_count`, `read_byte` or `blit` returns a made-up value. Reader's wrong program: a user machine calling an undeclared function with one of those names.

- CI/execution_scalars.rs:1615-1621 (enums of different types with the same variant name compare equal); 143 (cast to Bool of a non-boolean gives `false`); 708-774 (statement-position operator call skips the checked-selection cross-check).

GROUP: Checked interpreter (units 110 and 111): | - CI/filesystem_real.rs:106-118 with CI/build_machine.rs:985-991: `descriptor_root` returning `None` (unscoped run, or missing fd) skips the facet-root comparison. Reader's wrong program: in an unscoped real run, a Build descriptor operation naming a different facet's root is not rejected.

GROUP: Checked interpreter (units 110 and 111): | - CI/filesystem_real.rs:1268-1290: `real_seek` treats any `whence` other than 1 or 2 as start-relative; the virtual provider errors (CI/filesystem.rs:3880-3885).
